title: Book 7: The Nine-Figure Refusal & The Transfer Protocol (September 2018)
description: In September 2018, The Stardust Engine flies into Los Angeles, dismantles Omni-Global Media's $150 million leveraged buyout pitch with Clause 88 after Jameson Frost tries to butcher Cassidy's 'Ad Astra,' acquires the Burbank master-tape archive out of Chapter 11 bankruptcy, and recruits twins Jessica and Justin Miller back to Blacksburg.
